detaileddescription.para:
Called on the existing serial TX owner after its final programme graph. Only exactly one permits the block; all other results suppress programme. Generation and frames are actual radio/graph identities, never source timing. Bounded, allocation-free, no-unwind; never call a control or hardware API. Independent radio signaling is not gated. Inseparable voice telemetry is suppressed too: the controller must schedule/retry mandatory IDs separately.
context
Borrowed state retained until confirmed quiescent unbind.
generation
Actual immutable physical radio generation.
frames
Actual number of frames in this graph call.
Exactly one to permit this programme block; every other value denies.

Writable sized prefix shared by descriptor binds and ast_channel_setoption. Require zero return AND accepted_abi_version=1. Bind/rebind/unbind only after confirmed callback quiescence. Successful stop retains the binding for restart; failed start/stop does not authorize releasing it. Context/code remain live through stopped unbind/rebind or quiescent destruction/module unload. A missing capability cannot qualify private programme. An absent binding preserves ordinary PCM behavior; it is not an implicit private-media permit.
